claim: A ctl request written by a client that was killed before it withdrew stays in the ctl folder and runs in the next launch, in whatever context pumps first: J9's killed chain 3 left 'lua api_surface.lua -- land', answered 5 minutes later by the next launch's front-end pump (harness/runs/20261101_j9pc/raw/j9_land_stock_proxy.log 16:23:46); a stopped driver's child also sent kill and unlock to a later launch (chain 3)
notes: core fix proposed: the proxy drops requests older than its launch; engine_api.py keeps the last probe block per state
